en: The postcard consists of two black-and-white photographic images with a decorative border. The top image is labeled 'Kurhaus' and depicts a large, historic spa or resort building with neoclassical architecture, a grand staircase, and many people gathered on the terrace and stairs. The bottom image is labeled 'Allee 2. Goldfischteich' and shows a landscaped tree-lined avenue leading to a water feature, with a few individuals walking along the path. Both images are titled with German text, and at the bottom of the card, the name 'Bad Pyrmont' is prominently displayed. The back of the postcard includes the heading 'Postkarte' in German, a museum stamp for Bad Pyrmont, publisher details in Hamburg, and some handwritten numbers.
